Theorem 10 shows that for partial classes, having polynomial growth is not a sufficient condition for PAC learnability. A natural candidate reinstatement of the theorem is to work with the more restrictive assumption of linear growth. ▶ Problem 25. Let H ⊆ {0, 1, ⋆}X have polynomial growth with parameter 1. Does there exist a disambiguation H of H with VC(H) < ∞?
